        /*
         * Montserrat runs about a tenth wider than Arial, so text laid out in
         * the fallback while it downloads wraps a line short and reflows once
         * it lands. font-display: block hides that text but still lays it out,
         * so the shift happens either way. These faces scale the local fallback
         * to Montserrat's measure at each weight, holding the wrap point.
         * size-adjust is the ratio of the two fonts' average advance widths;
         * the vertical metrics are Montserrat's, divided by that same ratio so
         * the line box is unchanged. Only 400 and 800 are declared, matching
         * the two real Montserrat faces; heavier requests such as 900 render
         * at Montserrat 800, so they fall to the 800 fallback here too.
         */

    <script>
        window.an       = window.an || {};
        window.an.queue = window.an.queue || [];

        window.an.downloadInitFile = function(environment){

            if(!environment){

                throw new Error('Missing environment.');
            }

            let url = `https://adsninja.ca.${environment}/cached/v12`;

            if(['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)){

                url = 'https://cdn.adsninja.ca/v12';
            }
            else if(environment.match(/^(qa|ads|test|staging|stage|alpha|beta)\d*$/)){

                url = `https://${environment}.adsninja.ca/cached/v12`;
            }

            var version                           = Math.floor(Date.now() / 3e5);
            var anInitScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anInitScript.async                    = true;
            anInitScript.src                      = url + '/init.js?v=' + version;
            anInitScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anInitScript.id                       = "an-init";
            anInitScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anInitScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.href          = anInitScript.src;
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            var anSentinelScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anSentinelScript.async                    = true;
            anSentinelScript.src                      = url + '/an_sn.js?v=' + version;
            anSentinelScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anSentinelScript.id                       = "an-sentinel";
            anSentinelScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anSentinelScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.href          = anSentinelScript.src;
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            let addToHead = () => {

                let target = document.head || document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0]?.parentNode;

                if(target){

                    target.appendChild(anInitScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anInitScript);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScript);
                }
                else{

                    setTimeout(() => addToHead(), 100);
                }
            }

            addToHead();
        };
    </script>

    <script type="module">
        /** For Read More button on LP **/
        window.toggleReadmoreButton=()=>{
            let e=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc');
            for(let t=0;t<e.length;t++)e[t].classList.add('js-show-full');
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');
            for(let e=0;e<n.length;e++)n[e].classList.contains('js-show-btn')&&n[e].remove();
        }
        window.updateListingDescReadmoreButtons=()=>{
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');
            for(let t=0;t<n.length;t++){
                let e=n[t],i=e.previousElementSibling;
                if(!i||i.nodeType!==1||!i.classList.contains('listing-desc'))continue;
                if(i.classList.contains('js-show-full')){e.classList.remove('js-show-btn');continue}
                i.scrollHeight-i.clientHeight>1?e.classList.add('js-show-btn'):e.classList.remove('js-show-btn')
            }
        };
        let listingReadmoreResizeTimer;
        const runListingReadmoreUpdate=()=>{window.updateListingDescReadmoreButtons()};

    <script>
        window.an       = window.an || {};
        window.an.queue = window.an.queue || [];

        window.an.downloadInitFile = function(environment){

            if(!environment){

                throw new Error('Missing environment.');
            }

            let url = `https://adsninja.ca.${environment}/cached/v12`;

            if(['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)){

                url = 'https://cdn.adsninja.ca/v12';
            }
            else if(environment.match(/^(qa|ads|test|staging|stage|alpha|beta)\d*$/)){

                url = `https://${environment}.adsninja.ca/cached/v12`;
            }

            var version                           = Math.floor(Date.now() / 3e5);
            var anInitScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anInitScript.async                    = true;
            anInitScript.src                      = url + '/init.js?v=' + version;
            anInitScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anInitScript.id                       = "an-init";
            anInitScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anInitScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.href          = anInitScript.src;
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            var anSentinelScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anSentinelScript.async                    = true;
            anSentinelScript.src                      = url + '/an_sn.js?v=' + version;
            anSentinelScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anSentinelScript.id                       = "an-sentinel";
            anSentinelScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anSentinelScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.href          = anSentinelScript.src;
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            let addToHead = () => {

                let target = document.head || document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0]?.parentNode;

                if(target){

                    target.appendChild(anInitScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anInitScript);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScript);
                }
                else{

                    setTimeout(() => addToHead(), 100);
                }
            }

            addToHead();
        };
    </script>

                
    <script>
        (() => {
            
            let splitDelimitedString = (theString) => {

                if(!theString || typeof theString !== 'string'){

                    return [];
                }

                let splitString = theString.split('|');
                let result      = [];

                for(let value of splitString){

                    if(!value){

                        continue;
                    }

                    result.push(value);
                }

                return result;
            };

            // iOS Safari (Private Browsing / blocked storage / ITP) can throw on
            // localStorage access; guard it so a throw never aborts ad init.
            let safeLocalStorageGet = (key) => {

                try{

                    return localStorage.getItem(key);
                }
                catch(e){

                    return null;
                }
            };

            let environment       = 'production';
            let tags              = splitDelimitedString(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TAGS || '');
            let siteCategories    = splitDelimitedString(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CATEGORY || '');

            let pageDetails = {
                monetize: false,
                template: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TEMPLATE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TEMPLATE : null,
                source: 'organic',
                networkCategory: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_NETWORKCATEGORY) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_NETWORKCATEGORY : null,
                contentType: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CONTENTTYPE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CONTENTTYPE : null,
                pageId: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTID) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTID : null,
                extra: {
                    tags: tags,
                    siteCategories: siteCategories,
                    iabSiteCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SITECATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SITECATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    iabSectionCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SECTIONCATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SECTIONCATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    iabPageCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_PAGECATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_PAGECATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    intent: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_INTENT) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_INTENT : null,
                    segment: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_SEGMENT) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_SEGMENT : null,
                    postType: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTTYPE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTTYPE : null,
                    flaggedKeywords: [],
                }
            };

            let userDetails = {
                loggedIn: (!!window.isUserLoggedIn),
                tier: 'free',
                extra: {
                    blockConverted: (safeLocalStorageGet('userWasMuraledBefore') === 'true' || (safeLocalStorageGet('muralWasPresent') === 'true' && safeLocalStorageGet('userHasMural') === null)),
                },
            };

            if(window.isPremiumUser){

                userDetails.tier = 'premium';
            }

            if(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS && Array.isArray(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS) && window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS.length){

                pageDetails.extra.flaggedKeywords = [];

                for(let flaggedWord of window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS){

                    if(flaggedWord && typeof flaggedWord === 'object' && flaggedWord.hasOwnProperty('id')){

                        pageDetails.extra.flaggedKeywords.push(flaggedWord.id);
                    }
                }
            }

            if(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER && typeof window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER === 'object' && 1 <= Object.keys(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER).length){

                
                            }

            window.an.downloadInitFile(environment);

            window.an.queue.unshift(() => {

                window.an.init(
                    {
                        id: 'POLY',
                        name: 'Polygon',
                        shortName: 'POLY',
                    },
                    (['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)) ? 'live' : environment, // TODO: Fix AdsNinja environment.
                    pageDetails,
                    userDetails
                );
            });
        })();
    </script>

<div class="content-block-regular"><p>When <a href="https://www.polygon.com/avatar-seven-havens-trailer-sdcc-2026/" target="_blank"><em>Avatar: Seven Havens</em></a>, the second sequel series to <em>Last Airbender</em>, arrives to Paramount Plus on Oct. 9, it won’t pick up where <em><a href="https://www.polygon.com/game/the-legend-of-korra/37593/" target="_blank">The Legend of Korra</a> </em>left off. Not even close. Creators Bryan Konietzko and Michael Dante DiMartino are sending the Avatar franchise somewhere it has never gone before: a future where the world has been ravaged by a mysterious cataclysm, the boundaries between the physical and spirit worlds have been shattered, and the Avatar is no longer automatically regarded as humanity’s savior.</p>    <!-- No AdsNinja v10 Client! --><!-- No AdsNinja v10 Client! --><p>But just how far into the future? Polygon got a few answers in time for our big <a href="https://www.polygon.com/polygons-2026-fall-preview/" target="_blank">2026 Fall Preview</a>.</p>    <p>The new series follows Pavi, a young Earthbender who discovers she is the latest Avatar as she navigates the scattered settlements of a civilization that has very good reason to be afraid of what she represents. Even the setting, from the Moebius-inspired city of Ellora to the series’ striking new visual language courtesy of Paris-based <a href="https://www.polygon.com/dragon-striker-season-2-release-date/" target="_blank">Chouette Studios</a>, signals this isn’t simply another chapter in the familiar Avatar world. Based on what Konietzko and DiMartino discussed at SDCC earlier this year, and <a href="https://www.polygon.com/5-key-takeaways-from-the-avatar-seven-havens-trailer/" target="_blank">what we saw in the first trailer</a>, Pavi’s journey will eventually force her to reckon with the strange legacy of the Avatar before her.</p>    <p>Ready for a little more background? We pitched DiMartino and executive producers Ethan Spaulding and Sehaj Sethi a few burning questions over email, and they whetted our appetite for details. No spoilers, but fun teases ahead.</p>            <div class="w-display-card-vignette">
        <div
	style="display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:24px 16px;">

<p><strong>Polygon: How did you land on this particular setting/time jump? Did it start with the character?</strong></p>    <p><strong>Michael Dante DiMartino:</strong> When Bryan and I came back to Nickelodeon to start Avatar Studios, we had ideas for several different projects and one of them was a new series about the earthbending Avatar after Korra. This was in early 2021, so about six years after the <em>Legend of Korra</em>'s Book 4 finale had aired.</p>    <p>This idea started with the setting and the desire to drop the viewer into a world that had experienced a cataclysmic event. Then we threw around ideas for what kind of Avatar would make the most sense in this world. We settled on Pavi, a girl who lives in hiding and who is younger than both Aang and Korra. We thought it would be interesting to place this kind-hearted character into a world that was not only on the brink of collapse, but whose citizens reviled the Avatar.</p>    <p>The choice to make her such an underdog gave us a lot of potential drama that could sustain a series. Early on, we also decided we wanted this to be more of a mystery show than the last two series, so that a viewer would enter the story with a lot of questions: How did the world get so bad? Why does everyone hate the Avatar? How did Pavi lose her leg? We want the audience to always hunger to know more.</p>

<p><strong>How many years after Korra does </strong><strong><em>Avatar: Seven Havens</em></strong><strong> take place?</strong></p>    <p><strong>Sehaj Sethi:</strong> <em>Avatar: Seven Havens</em> takes place about 225 years after <em>Legend of Korra</em> ends. While the world is very fantastical, it is still greatly influenced by AAPI and Indigenous cultures and histories. For example, the name Ellora is inspired by the ancient Indian complex of monasteries and temples known as the Ellora Caves. Just as this ancient complex is a harmonious mix of several religious practices (Buddhism, Hinduism, Jainism), Ellora (along with the other Havens) is a harmonious blend of all bending practices.</p>    <p><strong>Ethan Spaulding: </strong>Viewers will notice <em>Seven Havens</em> has more of a fantasy look to the overall look of the Havens and clothing; there has been a blending of cultures during the time span since the previous series. The real-world elements are still there in a less obvious way.</p>

<p> <strong>What can you tease about Ellora as a new home for the Avatar? What kind of city is it compared to what fans have seen in the past?</strong></p>    

                
<p><strong>Sethi: </strong>Ellora is a sprawling metropolis set within a system of slot canyons, which creates a natural defensive barrier against the vicious sandstorms and tornadoes that attack the landscape just outside of Ellora’s borders.</p>    <p><strong>Spaulding: </strong>Ellora is a massive Haven with a population estimated at a million plus! Ellora’s design is based on survival. Most of the structures are shielded from the constant storms that have been ravaging the planet since the cataclysm. Aside from the city center, which is exposed, most of Ellora’s population is tucked safely within slot canyons.</p>    <p><strong>Sethi: </strong>Like each of our Havens, Ellora is a melting pot of all bending philosophies and cultures. What binds Ellorans together is an ideology focused on endurance and protection, which leads to their motto: “For the survival of Ellora.” Because Ellorans are so focused on survival, the rumor of the Avatar (considered the world’s destroyer) living in their midst leads to mass fear and panic. This gives Pavi’s story very high stakes. If her true identity is revealed, it could be disastrous.</p>    <hr /><p> Avatar: Seven Havens <em>premieres on Oct. 9 on Paramount Plus.</em></p>

apocalypse When Avatar: Seven Havens , the second sequel series to Last Airbender , arrives to Paramount Plus on Oct. 9, it won’t pick up where The Legend of Korra left off. Not even close. Creators Bryan Konietzko and Michael Dante DiMartino are sending the Avatar franchise somewhere it has never gone before: a future where the world has been ravaged by a mysterious cataclysm, the boundaries between the physical and spirit worlds have been shattered, and the Avatar is no longer automatically regarded as humanity’s savior. But just how far into the future? Polygon got a few answers in time for our big 2026 Fall Preview . The new series follows Pavi, a young Earthbender who discovers she is the latest Avatar as she navigates the scattered settlements of a civilization that has very good reason to be afraid of what she represents. Even the setting, from the Moebius-inspired city of Ellora to the series’ striking new visual language courtesy of Paris-based Chouette Studios , signals this isn’t simply another chapter in the familiar Avatar world. Based on what Konietzko and DiMartino discussed at SDCC earlier this year, and what we saw in the first trailer , Pavi’s journey will eventually force her to reckon with the strange legacy of the Avatar before her. Ready for a little more background? We pitched DiMartino and executive producers Ethan Spaulding and Sehaj Sethi a few burning questions over email, and they whetted our appetite for details. No spoilers, but fun teases ahead. Polygon: How did you land on this particular setting/time jump? Did it start with the character? Michael Dante DiMartino: When Bryan and I came back to Nickelodeon to start Avatar Studios, we had ideas for several different projects and one of them was a new series about the earthbending Avatar after Korra. This was in early 2021, so about six years after the Legend of Korra 's Book 4 finale had aired. This idea started with the setting and the desire to drop the viewer into a world that had experienced a cataclysmic event. Then we threw around ideas for what kind of Avatar would make the most sense in this world. We settled on Pavi, a girl who lives in hiding and who is younger than both Aang and Korra. We thought it would be interesting to place this kind-hearted character into a world that was not only on the brink of collapse, but whose citizens reviled the Avatar. The choice to make her such an underdog gave us a lot of potential drama that could sustain a series. Early on, we also decided we wanted this to be more of a mystery show than the last two series, so that a viewer would enter the story with a lot of questions: How did the world get so bad? Why does everyone hate the Avatar? How did Pavi lose her leg? We want the audience to always hunger to know more. How many years after Korra does Avatar: Seven Havens take place? Sehaj Sethi: Avatar: Seven Havens takes place about 225 years after Legend of Korra ends. While the world is very fantastical, it is still greatly influenced by AAPI and Indigenous cultures and histories. For example, the name Ellora is inspired by the ancient Indian complex of monasteries and temples known as the Ellora Caves. Just as this ancient complex is a harmonious mix of several religious practices (Buddhism, Hinduism, Jainism), Ellora (along with the other Havens) is a harmonious blend of all bending practices. Ethan Spaulding: Viewers will notice Seven Havens has more of a fantasy look to the overall look of the Havens and clothing; there has been a blending of cultures during the time span since the previous series. The real-world elements are still there in a less obvious way. What can you tease about Ellora as a new home for the Avatar? What kind of city is it compared to what fans have seen in the past? Sethi: Ellora is a sprawling metropolis set within a system of slot canyons, which creates a natural defensive barrier against the vicious sandstorms and tornadoes that attack the landscape just outside of Ellora’s borders. Spaulding: Ellora is a massive Haven with a population estimated at a million plus! Ellora’s design is based on survival. Most of the structures are shielded from the constant storms that have been ravaging the planet since the cataclysm. Aside from the city center, which is exposed, most of Ellora’s population is tucked safely within slot canyons. Sethi: Like each of our Havens, Ellora is a melting pot of all bending philosophies and cultures. What binds Ellorans together is an ideology focused on endurance and protection, which leads to their motto: “For the survival of Ellora.” Because Ellorans are so focused on survival, the rumor of the Avatar (considered the world’s destroyer) living in their midst leads to mass fear and panic. This gives Pavi’s story very high stakes. If her true identity is revealed, it could be disastrous. Avatar: Seven Havens premieres on Oct. 9 on Paramount Plus.     <script>
        window.an       = window.an || {};
        window.an.queue = window.an.queue || [];

        window.an.downloadInitFile = function(environment){

            if(!environment){

                throw new Error('Missing environment.');
            }

            let url = `https://adsninja.ca.${environment}/cached/v12`;

            if(['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)){

                url = 'https://cdn.adsninja.ca/v12';
            }
            else if(environment.match(/^(qa|ads|test|staging|stage|alpha|beta)\d*$/)){

                url = `https://${environment}.adsninja.ca/cached/v12`;
            }

            var version                           = Math.floor(Date.now() / 3e5);
            var anInitScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anInitScript.async                    = true;
            anInitScript.src                      = url + '/init.js?v=' + version;
            anInitScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anInitScript.id                       = "an-init";
            anInitScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anInitScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.href          = anInitScript.src;
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            var anSentinelScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anSentinelScript.async                    = true;
            anSentinelScript.src                      = url + '/an_sn.js?v=' + version;
            anSentinelScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anSentinelScript.id                       = "an-sentinel";
            anSentinelScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anSentinelScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.href          = anSentinelScript.src;
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            let addToHead = () => {

                let target = document.head || document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0]?.parentNode;

                if(target){

                    target.appendChild(anInitScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anInitScript);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScript);
                }
                else{

                    setTimeout(() => addToHead(), 100);
                }
            }

            addToHead();
        };
    </script>

                
    <script>
        (() => {
            
            let splitDelimitedString = (theString) => {

                if(!theString || typeof theString !== 'string'){

                    return [];
                }

                let splitString = theString.split('|');
                let result      = [];

                for(let value of splitString){

                    if(!value){

                        continue;
                    }

                    result.push(value);
                }

                return result;
            };

            // iOS Safari (Private Browsing / blocked storage / ITP) can throw on
            // localStorage access; guard it so a throw never aborts ad init.
            let safeLocalStorageGet = (key) => {

                try{

                    return localStorage.getItem(key);
                }
                catch(e){

                    return null;
                }
            };

            let environment       = 'production';
            let tags              = splitDelimitedString(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TAGS || '');
            let siteCategories    = splitDelimitedString(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CATEGORY || '');

            let pageDetails = {
                monetize: false,
                template: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TEMPLATE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TEMPLATE : null,
                source: 'organic',
                networkCategory: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_NETWORKCATEGORY) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_NETWORKCATEGORY : null,
                contentType: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CONTENTTYPE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CONTENTTYPE : null,
                pageId: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTID) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTID : null,
                extra: {
                    tags: tags,
                    siteCategories: siteCategories,
                    iabSiteCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SITECATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SITECATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    iabSectionCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SECTIONCATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SECTIONCATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    iabPageCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_PAGECATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_PAGECATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    intent: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_INTENT) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_INTENT : null,
                    segment: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_SEGMENT) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_SEGMENT : null,
                    postType: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTTYPE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTTYPE : null,
                    flaggedKeywords: [],
                }
            };

            let userDetails = {
                loggedIn: (!!window.isUserLoggedIn),
                tier: 'free',
                extra: {
                    blockConverted: (safeLocalStorageGet('userWasMuraledBefore') === 'true' || (safeLocalStorageGet('muralWasPresent') === 'true' && safeLocalStorageGet('userHasMural') === null)),
                },
            };

            if(window.isPremiumUser){

                userDetails.tier = 'premium';
            }

            if(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS && Array.isArray(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS) && window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS.length){

                pageDetails.extra.flaggedKeywords = [];

                for(let flaggedWord of window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS){

                    if(flaggedWord && typeof flaggedWord === 'object' && flaggedWord.hasOwnProperty('id')){

                        pageDetails.extra.flaggedKeywords.push(flaggedWord.id);
                    }
                }
            }

            if(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER && typeof window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER === 'object' && 1 <= Object.keys(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER).length){

                
                            }

            window.an.downloadInitFile(environment);

            window.an.queue.unshift(() => {

                window.an.init(
                    {
                        id: 'POLY',
                        name: 'Polygon',
                        shortName: 'POLY',
                    },
                    (['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)) ? 'live' : environment, // TODO: Fix AdsNinja environment.
                    pageDetails,
                    userDetails
                );
            });
        })();

<section id="article-body" class="article-body valnet-segment-Gaming" itemprop="articleBody">    



    
    
<div class="content-block-regular"><p>Blizzard Entertainment's once-annual fan gathering, BlizzCon, officially returns in 2026 for the first time in three years. <strong>BlizzCon 2026</strong> promises big reveals for Blizzard's stable of franchises, with news expected for <a href="https://www.polygon.com/game/world-of-warcraft/2735/" target="_blank">World of Warcraft</a>, <a href="https://www.polygon.com/diablo/" target="_blank">Diablo</a>, <a href="https://www.polygon.com/overwatch/" target="_blank">Overwatch</a>, <a href="https://www.polygon.com/game/hearthstone-heroes-of-warcraft/11322/" target="_blank">Hearthstone</a>, and even <a href="https://www.polygon.com/game/starcraft/7118/" target="_blank">StarCraft</a>. Given Blizzard's history of reviving its older games — including <em>StarCraft Remastered</em>, <em>Warcraft 3 Reforged</em>, and <em>Diablo 2: Resurrected</em> — and total rebrands – reverting <em>Overwatch 2</em> to <em>Overwatch</em> — anything seems to be on the table.</p>    <!-- No AdsNinja v10 Client! --><!-- No AdsNinja v10 Client! --><p>For Blizzard fans who can't visit BlizzCon 2026 in person or can't watch the show in real-time, we're rounding up the biggest news from BlizzCon 2026 below.</p>

            for(let t=0;t<e.length;t++)e[t].classList.add('js-show-full');
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');

https://www.polygon.com/blizzcon-2026-ne.visible_text: BlizzCon 2026: All the Big News, Reveals, and Announcements Menu Zelda GTA 6 Guides Pokémon Like Follow Followed 1 1 More Action Add Us Newsletter Sign in Sign in Now Close What To Play What to Watch Gaming Submenu News Reviews Previews Features Entertainment Submenu News Reviews Features Pick a genre Submenu Anime Horror Sci-Fi Fantasy Guides Submenu Subnautica 2 Forza Horizon 6 Pokémon Go All Guides Videos Sign in Newsletter Array Copyright © 2026 www.polygon.com --> Close Like Follow Followed Thread 1 Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Link copied to clipboard By  Michael McWhertor Published Sep 12, 2026, 1:19 PM EDT News What's new from Warcraft, Diablo, Overwatch, and StarCraft BlizzCon 2026: The biggest news and reveals from Blizzard's big show Image: Blizzard Entertainment Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread 1 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Blizzard Entertainment's once-annual fan gathering, BlizzCon, officially returns in 2026 for the first time in three years. BlizzCon 2026 promises big reveals for Blizzard's stable of franchises, with news expected for World of Warcraft , Diablo , Overwatch , Hearthstone , and even StarCraft . Given Blizzard's history of reviving its older games — including StarCraft Remastered , Warcraft 3 Reforged , and Diablo 2: Resurrected — and total rebrands – reverting Overwatch 2 to Overwatch — anything seems to be on the table. For Blizzard fans who can't visit BlizzCon 2026 in person or can't watch the show in real-time, we're rounding up the biggest news from BlizzCon 2026 below. By  Tomas Franzese Overwatch's next 'vampire fantasy' hero Doctrine revealed at BlizzCon Image: Blizzard Entertainment Blizzard detailed what players can expect from Overwatch ’s next season during the franchise’s BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony segment. A new vampiric hero named Doctrine is coming to the game, as is the Grímsvötn map and the return of Dokiwatch cosmetics. This BlizzCon’s Overwatch cinematic focused on Doomfist’s efforts to keep control of Talon after almost being killed. He works with agents like Sombra to free Doctrine, who suits up again and prepares to fight alongside his sect of Talon. Read Article > By  Tomas Franzese Hearthstone charts out exciting year ahead with new expansion and Monk class During the opening ceremony for BlizzCon 2026 , Blizzard Entertainment detailed what’s next for its long-lasting collectible card game Hearthstone . Its next expansion, Reign of the Black Empire , will put a greater emphasis on narrative than ever before. Then, in 2027, a brand-new class is coming to the game. What to expect from Reign of the Black Empire Read Article > By  Michael McWhertor Blizzard announces World of Warcraft Forever, the 'Classic Plus' fans have demanded Image: Blizzard Entertainment After months of rumors, speculation, and leaks, Blizzard Entertainment confirmed that World of Warcraft Classic Plus — the community's speculative name for a new spin on a classic, "vanilla" version of the enduring Warcraft MMO — is real. The official name for the project is World of Warcraft Forever , and it's coming very, very soon, Blizzard announced at BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony. Holly Longdale, executive producer and vice president for World of Warcraft , introduced World of Warcraft Forever as a version of the game that's "friendly, familiar, and new." Forever will focus on the world as the main character, "a place dedicated to community and making sure it's nurtured," Longdale said. Read Article > By  Michael McWhertor Blizzard reveals BlizzCon 2026-exclusive in-game cosmetics for WoW, Overwatch, and Diablo Image: Blizzard Entertainment BlizzCon , the once-annual gathering of Blizzard Entertainment fans, returns in September with fresh game reveals and updates, behind-the-scenes stories, and community events. While BlizzCon is focused on bringing people together, it's also marked by special in-game cosmetics and other perks that will give both attendees and viewers at home something to remember 2026's event by. On Wednesday, Blizzard announced a long list of BlizzCon 2026-themed skins, mounts, and in-game bonuses coming to games like World of Warcraft , Diablo 4 , and Overwatch . The BlizzCon Digital Bundles and BlizzCon Ultimate Collection will let players choose to buy virtual goods for a single game or for all five featured games. If you've ever wanted to dress up Mei from Overwatch as the Lich King Arthas, turning the sweet-mannered climatologist (and her sidekick Snowball) into a frosty force of evil, here's your chance. Read Article > By  Michael McWhertor Ahead of BlizzCon, Blizzard might be teasing a new StarCraft game Image: Blizzard Entertainment After nearly a decade in hibernation, StarCraft is (maybe) officially back. In the wake of a new report that Blizzard Entertainment is reviving StarCraft with help from Korean publisher Nexon, there appears to be some actual movement in the real-time strategy sci-fi game series — this time from Blizzard itself. With BlizzCon 2026 just days away, Blizzard fans are digging through clues that might be hinting at a new StarCraft project. On Thursday, fans discovered secret messages hidden on the official StarCraft website , with clues pointing at a follow-up to StarCraft 2: Legacy of the Void . Read Article > By  Willa Rowe How to watch BlizzCon 2026 and what to expect Image: Blizzard Entertainment This weekend, Blizzard will host BlizzCon 2026 , where fans can expect a plethora of announcements for franchises like World of Warcraft, StarCraft, Overwatch, and Diablo. While fans can attend the show in person, those not able to make it to the Anaheim Convention Center can tune in online to watch some of the convention's events. This year's BlizzCon already has a lot of buzz, with rumors of a new StarCraft game in the works surfacing just weeks before the event. Here's how to watch the show so you don't miss out on anything. Read Article > By  Michael McWhertor Diablo 5 officially announced at BlizzCon 2026 Image: Blizzard Entertainment It's official: The next Diablo game is coming. At BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony on Saturday, Blizzard Entertainment confirmed that it's currently developing Diablo 5 , the next mainline entry in the nearly 30-year-old Diablo franchise. For the sequel, Blizzard is bringing back the Lord of Terror himself, the original Diablo, who first terrorized heroic adventurers back in 1997. Blizzard was even bold enough to put a release date on the franchise's next game. Diablo 5 will be released in spring 2029, Blizzard announced at BlizzCon. Read Article > By  Michael McWhertor Two of Overwatch's most divisive heroes are getting game-changing reworks Image: Blizzard Entertainment Over the past decade, only a handful of Overwatch heroes have divided the player base as much as Roadhog and Sombra. Roadhog's Chain Hook has been a massive source of frustration for players on the receiving end of it, as squishier Overwatch heroes face almost certain death if the attack connects. And over the years, Sombra has consistently been one of the most-banned heroes on the game's roster, thanks to her annoying stealth- and hack-based kit. Blizzard announced at BlizzCon 2026 that it's addressing those two divisive heroes with dramatic reworks. That includes a role change for Sombra, who is moving from Overwatch 's damage group to the support group. Read Article > By  Tomas Franzese Heroes of the Storm is making an unexpected comeback in 2026 At BlizzCon 2026, Blizzard Entertainment announced a new hero for Heroes of the Storm : Xal’atath. He’s coming to the game later this month, and could signal a larger return of support for the game. World of Warcraft players will recognize Xal’atath as the Harbinger of the Void and a major player in the MMO’s recent Midnight expansion . Xal’atath will come to Heroes of the Storm's PTR next weekend, and is playable for those attending BlizzCon. Read Article > By  Michael McWhertor Blizzard reveals new Diablo series coming to Netflix Image: Blizzard Entertainment Blizzard Entertainment is finally expanding the "entertainment" half of its name. On Saturday, at BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony, Blizzard president Johanna Faries announced that it's teaming up with Netflix to bring the world of Diablo to streaming. A new animated series set in the world of Blizzard's demon-slaying franchise is coming to Netflix. And that's not all. Blizzard has plans to adapt more of its franchises, Faries teased. Read Article > By  Tomas Franzese StarCraft officially returns in 2030 with new open-world shooter Image: Blizzard Entertainment StarCraft is coming back, but not in the way that many longtime fans of the real-time strategy game series would expect. In 2030, Blizzard plans to release StarCraft , an open-world shooter that completely reimagines what the classic franchise can look like. Read Article > By  Tomas Franzese Diablo 4 brings back a fan-favorite class next year Image: Blizzard Entertainment While Diablo 5’s announcement was the most shocking reveal of BlizzCon 2026 , it’s not an indication that support for Diablo 4 is ending anytime soon. In fact, Blizzard's action RPG is being ported to a new platform, and a fan-favorite class from Diablo 2 is making its way into Diablo 4 . Diablo 4 will also get a major new season that will offer a playable look back at the franchise’s history. Read Article > By  Tomas Franzese Warcraft 3 just got its first new campaign in 23 years Image: Blizzard Entertainment Warcraft 3 just got a new campaign, as Forsaken Kingdom was shadow-dropped for Reforged version of the real-time strategy game at BlizzCon 2026. Forsaken Kingdom Read Article > By  Michael McWhertor Blizzard reveals first look at World of Warcraft's next expansion, The Last Titan Shortly after revealing a new look at World of Warcraft: Midnight 's next major update, known as Eclipse, Blizzard Entertainment teased the MMO's next major expansion at BlizzCon 2026. A brief teaser for World of Warcraft: The Last Titan was shown during BlizzCon's opening ceremony, hinting at what's in store for the third and final chapter in WoW's Worldsoul Saga. At BlizzCon 2026, Holly Longdale, executive producer and vice president for World of Warcraft, promised a "kick-ass year for Warcraft," before introducing Ion Hazzikostas, game designer, who set up what players will experience in World of Warcraft 's Eclipse update. Read Article > By  Michael McWhertor Overwatch's new hero Doctrine is instantly fascinating and fun Image: Blizzard Entertainment Overwatch 's new hero Doctrine was revealed Saturday at BlizzCon 2026 and pitched by Blizzard Entertainment as a vampire-inspired support hero with a high mechanical floor. The new Support-class hero also brings a new mechanic to the game, allowing him to "Infuse" his weapon and other abilities to strategically deploy a power boost during critical moments. At BlizzCon, we got our first hands-on experience with Doctrine, and a look at the full kit of Doomfist's old ally. While Doctrine does have some complexity to his suite of abilities, he's instantly fun to play with, with elements that will appeal to offense-minded healers, Reaper players who get queued into support, and anyone with a bit of a goth streak. Read Article > By  Tomas Franzese Blizzard reveals Diablo 5's new Plague Knight class at BlizzCon Image: Blizzard Entertainment Shortly after its reveal at the BlizzCon 2026's Opening Ceremony , a panel dedicated to revealing more about the newly-announced Diablo 5 was held. We not only learned more about the game's narrative and focus on procedural generation there, but also learned that it will introduce at least one new class at launch. What Diablo 5 classes were revealed at BlizzCon 2026? Read Article > By  Tomas Franzese Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is Overwatch's next big anime collaboration Image: CD Projekt Red/Trigger At BlizzCon, Blizzard Entertainment and CD Projekt Red delved into several upcoming collaborations between the two companies . These include Battle.net versions of CD Projekt Red's RPGs, but also a Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collaboration for Overwatch .     <script>
        window.an       = window.an || {};
        window.an.queue = window.an.queue || [];

        window.an.downloadInitFile = function(environment){

            if(!environment){

                throw new Error('Missing environment.');
            }

            let url = `https://adsninja.ca.${environment}/cached/v12`;

            if(['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)){

                url = 'https://cdn.adsninja.ca/v12';
            }
            else if(environment.match(/^(qa|ads|test|staging|stage|alpha|beta)\d*$/)){

                url = `https://${environment}.adsninja.ca/cached/v12`;
            }

            var version                           = Math.floor(Date.now() / 3e5);
            var anInitScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anInitScript.async                    = true;
            anInitScript.src                      = url + '/init.js?v=' + version;
            anInitScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anInitScript.id                       = "an-init";
            anInitScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anInitScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.href          = anInitScript.src;
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            var anSentinelScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anSentinelScript.async                    = true;
            anSentinelScript.src                      = url + '/an_sn.js?v=' + version;
            anSentinelScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anSentinelScript.id                       = "an-sentinel";
            anSentinelScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anSentinelScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.href          = anSentinelScript.src;
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            let addToHead = () => {

                let target = document.head || document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0]?.parentNode;

                if(target){

                    target.appendChild(anInitScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anInitScript);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScript);
                }
                else{

                    setTimeout(() => addToHead(), 100);
                }
            }

            addToHead();
        };
    </script>

                
    <script>
        (() => {
            
            let splitDelimitedString = (theString) => {

                if(!theString || typeof theString !== 'string'){

                    return [];
                }

                let splitString = theString.split('|');
                let result      = [];

                for(let value of splitString){

                    if(!value){

                        continue;
                    }

                    result.push(value);
                }

                return result;
            };

            // iOS Safari (Private Browsing / blocked storage / ITP) can throw on
            // localStorage access; guard it so a throw never aborts ad init.
            let safeLocalStorageGet = (key) => {

                try{

                    return localStorage.getItem(key);
                }
                catch(e){

                    return null;
                }
            };

            let environment       = 'production';
            let tags              = splitDelimitedString(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TAGS || '');
            let siteCategories    = splitDelimitedString(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CATEGORY || '');

            let pageDetails = {
                monetize: false,
                template: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TEMPLATE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TEMPLATE : null,
                source: 'organic',
                networkCategory: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_NETWORKCATEGORY) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_NETWORKCATEGORY : null,
                contentType: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CONTENTTYPE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CONTENTTYPE : null,
                pageId: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTID) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTID : null,
                extra: {
                    tags: tags,
                    siteCategories: siteCategories,
                    iabSiteCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SITECATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SITECATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    iabSectionCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SECTIONCATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_SECTIONCATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    iabPageCategoriesIds: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_PAGECATEGORIESIDS) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_IAB_PAGECATEGORIESIDS : null,
                    intent: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_INTENT) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_INTENT : null,
                    segment: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_SEGMENT) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_SEGMENT : null,
                    postType: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTTYPE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTTYPE : null,
                    flaggedKeywords: [],
                }
            };

            let userDetails = {
                loggedIn: (!!window.isUserLoggedIn),
                tier: 'free',
                extra: {
                    blockConverted: (safeLocalStorageGet('userWasMuraledBefore') === 'true' || (safeLocalStorageGet('muralWasPresent') === 'true' && safeLocalStorageGet('userHasMural') === null)),
                },
            };

            if(window.isPremiumUser){

                userDetails.tier = 'premium';
            }

            if(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS && Array.isArray(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS) && window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS.length){

                pageDetails.extra.flaggedKeywords = [];

                for(let flaggedWord of window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS){

                    if(flaggedWord && typeof flaggedWord === 'object' && flaggedWord.hasOwnProperty('id')){

                        pageDetails.extra.flaggedKeywords.push(flaggedWord.id);
                    }
                }
            }

            if(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER && typeof window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER === 'object' && 1 <= Object.keys(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER).length){

                
                            }

            window.an.downloadInitFile(environment);

            window.an.queue.unshift(() => {

                window.an.init(
                    {
                        id: 'POLY',
                        name: 'Polygon',
                        shortName: 'POLY',
                    },
                    (['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)) ? 'live' : environment, // TODO: Fix AdsNinja environment.
                    pageDetails,
                    userDetails
                );
            });
        })();
    </script>

        /** For Read More button on LP **/
        window.toggleReadmoreButton=()=>{
            let e=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc');
            for(let t=0;t<e.length;t++)e[t].classList.add('js-show-full');
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');
            for(let e=0;e<n.length;e++)n[e].classList.contains('js-show-btn')&&n[e].remove();
        }
        window.updateListingDescReadmoreButtons=()=>{
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');
            for(let t=0;t<n.length;t++){
                let e=n[t],i=e.previousElementSibling;
                if(!i||i.nodeType!==1||!i.classList.contains('listing-desc'))continue;
                if(i.classList.contains('js-show-full')){e.classList.remove('js-show-btn');continue}
                i.scrollHeight-i.clientHeight>1?e.classList.add('js-show-btn'):e.classList.remove('js-show-btn')
            }
        };
        let listingReadmoreResizeTimer;
        const runListingReadmoreUpdate=()=>{window.updateListingDescReadmoreButtons()};
        if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',runListingReadmoreUpdate)}else{runListingReadmoreUpdate()}
        window.addEventListener('load',runListingReadmoreUpdate);
        window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(listingReadmoreResizeTimer);listingReadmoreResizeTimer=setTimeout(runListingReadmoreUpdate,100)});
    </script>

    <script>
        window.an       = window.an || {};
        window.an.queue = window.an.queue || [];

        window.an.downloadInitFile = function(environment){

            if(!environment){

                throw new Error('Missing environment.');
            }

            let url = `https://adsninja.ca.${environment}/cached/v12`;

            if(['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)){

                url = 'https://cdn.adsninja.ca/v12';
            }
            else if(environment.match(/^(qa|ads|test|staging|stage|alpha|beta)\d*$/)){

                url = `https://${environment}.adsninja.ca/cached/v12`;
            }

            var version                           = Math.floor(Date.now() / 3e5);
            var anInitScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anInitScript.async                    = true;
            anInitScript.src                      = url + '/init.js?v=' + version;
            anInitScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anInitScript.id                       = "an-init";
            anInitScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anInitScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.href          = anInitScript.src;
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anInitScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            var anSentinelScript                      = document.createElement("script");
            anSentinelScript.async                    = true;
            anSentinelScript.src                      = url + '/an_sn.js?v=' + version;
            anSentinelScript.type                     = 'text/javascript';
            anSentinelScript.id                       = "an-sentinel";
            anSentinelScript.fetchPriority            = 'high';
            var anSentinelScriptPreloadLink           = document.createElement("link");
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.rel           = 'preload';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.href          = anSentinelScript.src;
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.as            = 'script';
            anSentinelScriptPreloadLink.fetchPriority = 'high';

            let addToHead = () => {

                let target = document.head || document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0]?.parentNode;

                if(target){

                    target.appendChild(anInitScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anInitScript);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScriptPreloadLink);
                    target.appendChild(anSentinelScript);
                }
                else{

                    setTimeout(() => addToHead(), 100);
                }
            }

            addToHead();
        };
    </script>

                
    <script>
        (() => {
            
            let splitDelimitedString = (theString) => {

                if(!theString || typeof theString !== 'string'){

                    return [];
                }

                let splitString = theString.split('|');
                let result      = [];

                for(let value of splitString){

                    if(!value){

                        continue;
                    }

                    result.push(value);
                }

                return result;
            };

            // iOS Safari (Private Browsing / blocked storage / ITP) can throw on
            // localStorage access; guard it so a throw never aborts ad init.
            let safeLocalStorageGet = (key) => {

                try{

                    return localStorage.getItem(key);
                }
                catch(e){

                    return null;
                }
            };

            let environment       = 'production';
            let tags              = splitDelimitedString(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_TAGS || '');
            let siteCategories    = splitDelimitedString(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_CATEGORY || '');

            let pageDetails = {
                monetize: false,

                source: 'organic',

                    postType: (window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTTYPE) ? window.VALNET_GLOBAL_POSTTYPE : null,
                    flaggedKeywords: [],
                }
            };

            let userDetails = {
                loggedIn: (!!window.isUserLoggedIn),
                tier: 'free',
                extra: {
                    blockConverted: (safeLocalStorageGet('userWasMuraledBefore') === 'true' || (safeLocalStorageGet('muralWasPresent') === 'true' && safeLocalStorageGet('userHasMural') === null)),
                },
            };

            if(window.isPremiumUser){

                userDetails.tier = 'premium';

                pageDetails.extra.flaggedKeywords = [];

                for(let flaggedWord of window.VALNET_GLOBAL_FLAGGEDWORDS){

                    if(flaggedWord && typeof flaggedWord === 'object' && flaggedWord.hasOwnProperty('id')){

                        pageDetails.extra.flaggedKeywords.push(flaggedWord.id);
                    }
                }
            }

            if(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER && typeof window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER === 'object' && 1 <= Object.keys(window.VALNET_GLOBAL_USER).length){

                
                            }

            window.an.downloadInitFile(environment);

            window.an.queue.unshift(() => {

                window.an.init(
                    {
                        id: 'POLY',
                        name: 'Polygon',
                        shortName: 'POLY',
                    },
                    (['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)) ? 'live' : environment, // TODO: Fix AdsNinja environment.
                    pageDetails,
                    userDetails
                );
            });
        })();

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            var queryString = window.location.search || '';
            var keyValPairs = [];
            var params      = {};

            queryString     = queryString.substr(1);
            if (queryString.length)
            {
                keyValPairs = queryString.split('&');
                for (var i = 0; i < keyValPairs.length; i++)
                {
                    var key = keyValPairs[i].split('=')[0];
                    if (!key.length) continue;
                    if (typeof params[key] === 'undefined')
                        params[key] = [];
                    params[key].push(keyValPairs[i].split('=')[1]);
                }

                if (params['view'] !== undefined) {
                    if (params['view'] == "list" || params['view'] == "lista") {
                        valnet_cookie.set("view",params['view']);
                    }
                }

                var campaign = null;
                if (params['utm_source'] !== undefined) {
                    campaign = params['utm_source'];
                }
                if (campaign !== null) {
                    valnet_cookie.set("campaign",campaign);
                }
            }
        });
    </script>

        
                                                        
    <script type="module">
        /** For Read More button on LP **/
        window.toggleReadmoreButton=()=>{
            let e=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc');
            for(let t=0;t<e.length;t++)e[t].classList.add('js-show-full');
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');
            for(let e=0;e<n.length;e++)n[e].classList.contains('js-show-btn')&&n[e].remove();
        }
        window.updateListingDescReadmoreButtons=()=>{
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');
            for(let t=0;t<n.length;t++){
                let e=n[t],i=e.previousElementSibling;
                if(!i||i.nodeType!==1||!i.classList.contains('listing-desc'))continue;
                if(i.classList.contains('js-show-full')){e.classList.remove('js-show-btn');continue}
                i.scrollHeight-i.clientHeight>1?e.classList.add('js-show-btn'):e.classList.remove('js-show-btn')
            }
        };
        let listingReadmoreResizeTimer;
        const runListingReadmoreUpdate=()=>{window.updateListingDescReadmoreButtons()};
        if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',runListingReadmoreUpdate)}else{runListingReadmoreUpdate()}
        window.addEventListener('load',runListingReadmoreUpdate);
        window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(listingReadmoreResizeTimer);listingReadmoreResizeTimer=setTimeout(runListingReadmoreUpdate,100)});
    </script>
